meta.name: abp-framework
meta.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4/10.5) core guide: solution templates (app, app-nolayers, microservice), layered architecture, module system, base classes (ApplicationService/DomainService), Clock/GuidGenerator/CurrentUser/LazyServiceProvider, .NET 10. Use when creating an ABP project, or when architecture or core conventions are needed.

howto.when: 当用户提到“ABP project”、“abp new”或询问ABP架构、最佳实践时触发。
